name: @defold-typescript/library-docs
description: Static documentation site for the libraries in packages/library-types/data, built with Waku and Fumadocs.

scripts.build-indexes: bun ../docs-render/scripts/write-critical-css.ts public && bun scripts/build-search-index.ts && bun scripts/build-symbol-index.ts
scripts.build: bun run build-model && bun run build-indexes
scripts.build:site: bun run build && bun --bun waku build
scripts.dev: bun run build && bun --bun waku dev
